temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him; he feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: his suspicion is confirmed. Jonathan was hiding something, specifically that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding something important and is currently in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before; after the admission, worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront Jonathan and uncover the truth about what he is hiding.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts that he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian learns Jonathan's trouble is serious and complicated, and that Jonathan is reluctant to involve him but needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs help; Christian is committed to supporting him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer help and support to Jonathan and face the trouble together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself. Christian says he will look into it discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs help; Christian now suspects the trouble may be related to criminal activity or wrong people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, partially: the possibility of involvement with wrong people is strengthened, but Jonathan denies illegal acts, leaving uncertainty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble likely involves dangerous or wrong people; Jonathan may be innocent but is at risk. Christian needs to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Investigate the matter discreetly to find out the truth and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up. He tells Jonathan he has leads and will gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble involves dangerous or wrong people; Jonathan may be innocent but the situation is risky.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian now believes Jonathan is not the wrongdoer but is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed and is innocent; Christian must clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he has found out who is behind the frame-up: someone both of them know and trust. Jonathan warns him to be careful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed; Christian is gathering evidence, and the real culprit is not yet identified as someone close.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian identifies or realizes that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them is responsible for the betrayal and framing; this person must be brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront the real culprit and bring them to justice while protecting Jonathan.
